item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes a statutory determination under section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C); the determination's legally operative consequence occurs upon the presidential finding, with its substantive object completed in segment 2.","evidence":"I determine, pursuant to section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"This segment supplies the substantive finding of the President's present statutory determination—that alternative petroleum supplies are sufficient to permit a significant reduction in Iranian purchases. The additional statement about continued monitoring does not postpone that legal consequence.","evidence":"that there is a sufficient supply of petroleum and petroleum products from countries other than Iran to permit a significant reduction"}]}
